conviction_note: The fall is a sell-the-news reversal: the stock was up about 30% pre-market and opened +18.8% on the company's own Envoy closing release, then sold off 32.7% intraday. With the catalyst spent, no repricing mechanism, a continuing low-cost seller (LHT I's 2.8M settlement shares at $0.386, more than the 2.34M outstanding on 2026-09-24) and the base rates for heavy volume and high ATR, I lean slightly negative: p_up 44 on an abs move of 12% gives -1.44, close to the single finding's -1.0.

cause.label: corporate_action
cause.what_happened: Before the open on Monday 2026-10-12, Dot Ai (CID HoldCo) announced it had completed the $65M all-stock Envoy Technologies acquisition and said it believed the deal cures Nasdaq Capital Market stockholders' equity. The stock was up about 30% pre-market (StocksToTrade, 08:32 ET: +32.7%) and opened +18.8%, then sold off 32.7% intraday on 84x normal volume. This is sell-the-news into a tiny float with a dilution overhang, not new bad news.

evidence.claim: Dot Ai completed the $65M all-stock acquisition of Envoy from BladeRanger; the Envoy $12.5M convertible note stays outstanding and converts after stockholder approval and an effective resale registration; the company will submit evidence of compliance with the $2.5M equity standard to the Nasdaq Hearings Panel, whose confirmation is still required
GlobeNewswire release dated 2026-10-12 (403 from here, so only the headline is confirmed through the URL path)
pre-market at 08:32 ET the stock was trending up 32.7%; cash $456,069 against more than $13.5M of liabilities
No EDGAR filing after the 10-Q/A of 2026-10-02 as of the screen; the closing 8-K has not been filed yet

pipeline.next_dated_event: The closing 8-K (Items 2.01/3.02/5.01) is due within four business days of 2026-10-12, so by 2026-10-16; it may or may not land inside the window. The Nasdaq Hearings Panel written decision is pending since the 2026-09-15 hearing and has no date.
pipeline.what_would_change_my_mind: A Nasdaq Hearings Panel decision granting continued listing on the Capital Market, filed before the 2026-10-13 close, would be a dated positive for an issuer whose biggest open question is delisting.

positioning_check: Nasdaq short interest, settlement 2026-09-30: 185,077 shares, 1.0 days to cover, down 5.6% from 195,957 on 2026-09-15 (https://api.nasdaq.com/api/quote/DAIC/short-interest?assetclass=stocks). FINRA publishes about eight business days after settlement, so the position carried into today is not observable. Against 2,337,767 shares outstanding on 2026-09-24 (10-Q cover) that is about 8% of shares, not crowded at 1 day to cover. No insider trades in 3 or 12 months (Nasdaq insider API). No usable option chain, so no skew.

findings.finding: A low-cost seller is not finished. The 2026-09-15 settlement converts $1,086,785 owed to LHT I into 2,815,506 common shares at $0.386, against 2,337,767 shares outstanding on 2026-09-24, and the cover count shows those shares were not yet issued then. On top of that sit the H Capital $550k convertible note (lower of $1.50 or 90% of the 10-day VWAP, floor $0.50) and the White Lion equity facility. That supply sells into any bounce on 2026-10-13.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The settlement shares were committed on 2026-09-15 and convert at a fifth of spot; each issued tranche is sellable as soon as it is delivered, and the closing 8-K or a later filing will disclose the new share count. The pressure acts every session, including the window session, not at one later date.
findings.resolves_by: 2026-10-13: continuous flow through the window session
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the 2026-09-17 spike on the Envoy term sheet the stock fell about 21% the next day (tickeron, 2026-09-18) and then went from the $5s to about $2.4 over three weeks. In the baseline, its own comparable falls have a median next close of -5.38% with 42.9% up.
findings.why_not_priced: The overhang has been public since 2026-09-16, so the level is priced. What the close does not hold is the flow: issuance timing is not disclosed, and a seller at $0.386 sells any rebound tomorrow. If the market held it, today's intraday collapse would have stopped at the open rather than running 32.7%. I keep the size small because the fact is public.
findings.independence: The 10-Q of 2026-09-25 independently confirms the settlement, the cover count of 2,337,767 (= 1,966,042 + 371,725 White Lion warrant shares, so the LHT shares were not in it), the going-concern doubt and cash of $456,069: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/2033770/000121390026103514/ea0306501-10q_cidhold.htm

outside_window.finding: Nasdaq Hearings Panel written decision on the MVLS, MVPHS and delinquent-10-Q deficiencies; the hearing was held 2026-09-15 and the company is now submitting Capital Market equity compliance evidence after the Envoy close. Binary and undated: a denial would be strongly negative, a grant positive, and MVLS remains far short ($50M against roughly $5-10M of common).
Closing 8-K (Items 2.01/3.02/5.01, change of control to BladeRanger on an as-converted basis), due by 2026-10-16; the content is mostly in the release already, and it may land after the window.

Series C preferred (10.6M shares, more than 4x the common count) converts one for one after a stockholder vote targeted by 2027-01-31; BladeRanger's conversion shares are locked up to the earlier of 2027-04-01 or six months after conversion; Envoy's $12.5M note converts after approval and an effective resale S-1.

LHT I / J.J. Astor loan installments run to the 2026-11-30 maturity, and the executive notes' final payment is due by 2026-12-31, against cash of $456,069 at 2026-06-30 and substantial doubt about going concern.

rejected_candidates.detail: The release itself says continued listing depends on Panel confirmation, and the tape bought that headline pre-market (+30%) before selling it, so there is no unread document and no mechanism.

baseline_tension: What I found agrees with the 84x volume, the 21% ATR and this name's own history of falls (median -5.38%, 42.9% up), all of which lean toward continuation. I lean toward 50 rather than all the way to that history because a gap-up reversal on spent good news, with no further bad news dated inside the window, is not a second shoe.
